description: Page OpenVibe.Chat's stored messages of one channel, stream, person, anonymous id or name, or read one by id, with a cursor on the message id and the latest id: for OpenVibe.Live's AI context, clip and viewer jobs and its moderator search and history (plan T3, J4b).
